description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Event' model class within the Opencart framework, specifically within the 'Admin' module's 'Setting' namespace. The class manages CRUD operations for event records in the database, including adding, deleting, updating, and retrieving event data.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A model class for managing event data within the Opencart framework, providing methods to create, read, update, and delete event records in the database.

methods.name: addEvent
methods.description: Creates a new event record in the database with provided data and returns the new event's primary key.

methods.name: deleteEvent
methods.description: Deletes an event record from the database based on its primary key.

methods.name: deleteEventByCode
methods.description: Deletes an event record from the database based on its unique code.

methods.name: editStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of an event record identified by its primary key.

methods.name: editStatusByCode
methods.description: Updates the status of an event record identified by its code.

methods.name: getEvent
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event record from the database by its primary key.

methods.name: getEventByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a specific event record from the database by its code.

methods.name: getEvents
methods.description: Retrieves a list of event records based on optional filtering and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getTotalEvents
methods.description: Returns the total count of event records based on optional filters.
